summary: Iteration-4 E2E of GezGelir Web Push (VAPID) + Home missing-documents reminder + full regression. Backend: 60/60 pytest cases PASS against the public URL. Added new TestPush (7 cases: /api/push/public-key returns an ~87-char base64url VAPID public key without auth; subscribe/unsubscribe/test all 401 without Bearer; subscribe is idempotent (same endpoint twice -> ok:true, upsert); unsubscribe removes it; /api/push/test creates an 'info' notification and increments unread; drive/stop with a BOGUS push subscription endpoint still returns 200 in <15s -> push send is non-blocking/best-effort; notification bodies contain Turkish-formatted numbers ('41,0 km' / '₺x,yz')) plus a new doc-reminder assertion (fresh register has seeded 'Belgelerini tamamla' notification and /api/documents reports 0/3 approved). Updated the iteration-3 fresh-register-seeded-count assertion (was ==4/==2) to >=4/>=2 since iteration 4 legitimately adds a 5th seeded notification. Frontend (390x844 mobile, chromium): fresh-registered a new user, doc-reminder-card renders with '3 belgen eksik' text, tapping it opens documents-sheet, uploading all 3 docs (ehliyet/ruhsat/arac_foto) via each doc-upload-<slot> button + file chooser flips their StatusBadge and, after reload, the reminder card is gone (count=0). Notification bell shows unread badge, notification-sheet lists notification-item rows, mark-all-read works. push-toggle renders and — in a headless chromium context where the SW push manager / Notifications are unavailable — correctly falls back to a DISABLED 'İzin reddedildi — tarayıcı ayarlarından aç' state without crashing the UI (per acceptance criteria: 'treat inability to grant OS/browser permission as a non-blocking environment limitation'). Turkish currency/formatting is used everywhere on Home ('₺337,80', '112,6 km', '₺1.240,60') so the iteration-3 locale-formatting cosmetic issue is resolved and asserted server-side.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _send_push is scheduled via asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor without a bounded thread pool — a large fanout with slow endpoints could saturate the default executor. Consider a dedicated ThreadPoolExecutor and/or a request-timeout wrapper on webpush() so a stuck TLS handshake cannot pin threads for minutes.

PushSubscribeIn uses {'endpoint': str, 'keys': {'p256dh','auth'}} but keys is unvalidated (dict). Add a nested Pydantic model so junk payloads (e.g., missing 'auth') fail fast at 422 instead of silently upserting and later failing on send.

get_vapid() stores the private key PEM in db.settings without any at-rest protection. For production, load VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY from an env/secret manager and only fall back to DB generation in dev; document rotation procedure.
sw.js is served at /sw.js; ensure the deployed cache-control does not cache it aggressively (SW updates rely on a byte-diff of the SW file — a long max-age freezes clients on the old version).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-4 flows verified (push toggle exercised as headless-denied graceful state per spec)

seed_data_creation: Registered TEST_push_/TEST_ntdocrem_/TEST_pusht_/TEST_pushbog_/TEST_nt0_ users during backend tests. Frontend registered uitest_<ts>@example.com and uploaded 3 tiny PNGs to ehliyet/ruhsat/arac_foto slots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: 60 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — TestAuth (7), TestScoping (12), TestBasics (3), TestTrips (2), TestEarnings (5), TestGamification (1), TestBankAccounts (3), TestWithdraw (4), TestDriveStop (1), TestDocuments (5), TestNotifications (8), TestPush (8). Fresh registrations receive >=5 seeded notifications (>=3 unread) including 'Belgelerini tamamla' — assert deltas or use >=. Documents: 3 slots (ehliyet/ruhsat/arac_foto) accepting image/* or PDF; status is time-based (İnceleniyor <30s -> Onaylandı). Web Push: VAPID public key exposed at /api/push/public-key (no auth); private key auto-generated and stored in db.settings id='vapid'; /api/push/test creates an 'info' notification in-DB regardless of whether a real push service is reachable; push send is fire-and-forget via run_in_executor and swallows WebPushException — safe to test with example.invalid endpoints. Frontend: DocumentsSheet uses ONE shared hidden file input [data-testid=document-file-input] driven by per-slot upload buttons [data-testid=doc-upload-<slot>] via a busyType state — to upload multiple slots in Playwright, click the per-slot button and use page.expect_file_chooser() for each (do not try to nth(idx) the shared input). push-toggle in headless chromium reports permission='denied' even after context.grant_permissions(['notifications']) because the Service Worker PushManager is not fully available; the button correctly disables and shows Turkish denied-state copy — treat this as a non-blocking env limitation, not a bug.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defects observed. Backend push endpoints implement the documented contracts, subscribe is idempotent via upsert on endpoint, and drive/stop remains prompt even with a bogus subscription because _send_push runs in an executor and exceptions are caught (expired 410/404 endpoints even self-clean from db.push_subs). Home reminder card is driven by GET /api/documents approved<total and hides correctly once all 3 slots have an upload. The iteration-3 Turkish-number-format cosmetic issue in notification bodies is now fixed (verified via a new assertion).
